criteria.criterion: runstat.loader.load_run(path) returns an object exposing run_id (the run directory's own name), sessions (session records sorted by file name) and iterations (the iterations.jsonl records as dicts, in file order).
criteria.evidence: src/runstat/loader.py:76 returns Run(run_id=path.name, sessions=sessions, iterations=iterations); sessions built from sorted(sessions_dir.glob('*.json')) (line 45); iterations appended in read order (line 70). Confirmed by test_loads_good_fixture asserting exact phase/iteration ordering.

criteria.criterion: Each session record exposes phase, iteration, total_cost_usd, num_turns, duration_ms, is_error, permission_denials and the path it was read from.
criteria.evidence: Session dataclass at loader.py:18-27 has all seven fields; constructed at loader.py:50-61 including path=session_path.

criteria.criterion: runstat.loader.RunError is raised when the run directory does not exist, when any sessions/*.json file is not valid JSON, and when any non-blank line of iterations.jsonl is not valid JSON.
criteria.evidence: loader.py:40 (missing dir), :49 (bad session JSON), :74 (bad iterations line, guarded by blank-line skip at :67-68). All three exercised by tests and the inline verify command, which passed.

criteria.criterion: The RunError message names the offending file — the session file's name for a bad session, iterations.jsonl for a bad record line.
criteria.evidence: loader.py:49 'malformed session file: {session_path.name}'; loader.py:72-74 'malformed record in iterations.jsonl: {line!r}'. test_malformed_session_file_names_the_file and test_malformed_iterations_line_names_the_file check substring presence.

criteria.criterion: A run directory that exists but has no session files loads successfully with an empty sessions list; deciding what that means is the CLI's job, not the loader's. A missing iterations.jsonl is treated as zero records.
criteria.evidence: loader.py:44 guards sessions_dir.is_dir() (handles both absent and empty sessions/); loader.py:65 guards iterations_path.is_file(). test_no_session_files_loads_empty and test_missing_iterations_file_is_zero_records cover both.

criteria.criterion: Tests cover the good fixture and each malformed case, writing only inside tmp_path.
criteria.evidence: All six tests in tests/test_loader.py take tmp_path and write only under it (via write_fixture_run(tmp_path) or run_dir = tmp_path / ...).

notes: Only src/runstat/loader.py and tests/test_loader.py were touched by the work session (per git diff), matching the task's file list exactly. tests/fixtures.py predates this task (from T1/T2) and was reused, not modified. No absolute paths in new files.
